description: Überschwemmungsgebiete - vorläufig gesichert (Landkreis Heidekreis) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by heidekreis.de. Designation of the provisionally secured flood areas in the district of Heidekreis. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains – provisionally secured (Landkreis Heidekreis)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, inspireidentifiziert, GDIMRH, ÜSG. The listing shows 2015-03-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
